reviewer: human_visual_fidelity — AI coding agent, not a human tester
method: Independent read-only review of capture-fidelity.mjs, create-comparison.mjs and verify-regression-v70.mjs; no Chrome/build/Git/application write.

findings.finding: The first implementation displayed image hashes from reports without reading and hashing the referenced PNG copies. A missing or changed copy could receive a comparison_created result.
findings.resolution: Before HTML creation, read every before/after PNG and assert its actual SHA-256 matches the report. Paths remain relative; no external resources are introduced.

otherChecks: Capture helper pins exact clean production source/index/build-info/source fingerprint and verifies unchanged inputs.
Genuine gameplay cameras are preserved; collision traces, actual visible mesh rays and descriptive counters have explicit limits.
The copied regression driver retains all upstream scenario assertions; the co-op auxiliary helper is byte-identical to the historical source.
finalComparisonResult: 15 original screenshot pairs created only after all 30 referenced PNG files were read and their actual hashes matched.
limitations: This review is not a human player session, hardware performance measurement or film/prop fidelity certification.
